/setup-astack.description: Scaffold verify-<app> skills and repo guardrails once per project.

/create-verification-skill.description: Generate .agents/skills/verify-<app>/ and a live feature map.

/create-formal-verification-skill.description: Scaffold TLA+ or TypeScript bounded invariant verification checks.

/maintain-verification-skill.description: Audit and repair drifted verify-<app> checks against live app behavior.

/maintain-formal-verification-skill.description: Re-sync TLA+ or bounded TypeScript specs after code changes.

/astack-help.description: Pick the right skill, playbook, or multi-agent tier without running edits.

/plan.description: Investigate read-only and write implementation_plan.md before editing files.

/grill-me.description: Interview you one question at a time to sharpen a rough idea before planning.

/how.description: Trace how a subsystem works right now and which module owns it.

/why.description: Trace git history, PRs, and trackers for why code or limits exist.

/in-your-own-words.description: Restate the ticket or goal read-only to catch misreads before coding.

/sharpen.description: Rewrite an underspecified prompt deeper without executing edits.

/teach.description: Explain a subsystem or PR step by step with diagrams and rationale.

/recall.description: Reconstruct recent work from Antigravity transcripts and PR history.

/architect.description: Explore competing boundary designs in parallel and screen red flags.

/statechart.description: Model-check TLA+ state machines and render failing paths as Mermaid charts.

/figure-it-out.description: Design an auditable hypothesis loop for huge unmapped migrations.

/astack-mode.description: Run the full playbook to implement, clean the diff, and prove it works live.

/interrogate.description: Run multi-model adversarial review on a contested design or diff.

/deslop.description: Strip speculative helpers, shims, and bloat before committing.

/no-comments.description: Delete narrating comments and flag workarounds via comment-sicko.

/control-ui.description: Boot isolated UI servers and verify user flows in a real browser.

/control-cli.description: Verify CLIs, daemons, and HTTP APIs in isolated temp workspaces.

/tdd.description: Write a minimal failing behavioral test first on cheap local tests.

/typescript-best-practices.description: Enforce discriminated unions, unknown boundary parsing, and strict TypeScript.

/arena.description: Race competing candidates in isolated branches and graft the cleanest wins.

/fanout.description: Run parallel subagent slices or review arms and consolidate findings.

/design-audit.description: Audit desktop and mobile layout, keyboard nav, ARIA, and UI states live.

/benchmark-checklist.description: Vet performance speedups and regressions across seven empirical checks.

/show-me-your-work.description: Record an append-only TSV decision trail audited against transcripts.

/ketchup.description: Summarize recent changes and pending human decisions in plain prose.

/ketchup-video.description: Catch up on recent changes as a short subtitled slide video plus open decisions.

/bro.description: Restate the last agent message in plain human language with no jargon.

/review-pr.description: Compile pr-review.md and run an isolated verifier pass before opening a PR.

pr-dossier.mjs.description: Compile Risk Tier 0-3 blast radius, receipts, and pr-review.md.

pr-verifier.description: Run isolated fresh-context verification against base-branch REVIEW.md.

/security-audit.description: Run opt-in trust-boundary guidance or 6-phase vulnerability audits.

/blast-radius.description: Prove downstream caller, wire, and database safety by running real code.

/audit-architecture.description: Scan module boundaries, banned patterns, and shallow modules.

/astack-mode open the pr.description: Prepare clean commits, compile the PR proof block, and open the PR.

/astack-mode babysit.description: Watch CI, triage review threads skeptically, and drive the PR to merge-ready.

/technical-writing.description: Enforce clear active voice and Google/STE rules on docs and PR bodies.

/unslop.description: Remove AI writing tells, forced triplets, and filler from prose.

watch-pr.mjs.description: Poll GitHub PR checks, mergeability, and review threads to READY.

/astack-mode land the stack.description: Verify each PR via an independent verifier and merge bottom-up.

/astack-mode release-and-postmortem.description: Write release notes, run post-deploy smoke checks, and close incidents.

/correct.description: Encode recurring mistakes into types, lints, tests, or rules.

/reflect.description: Mine session transcripts to propose targeted skill improvements.

/automate-me.description: Distill recurring session habits into a personal workflow skill.

/make-bot-ui.description: Build a local or Tailscale button UI that wakes an automation webhook safely.

/astack-mode prune worktrees.description: Audit stale git worktrees and clones safely before removing them.

/swarm.description: Spawn named workers with isolated workspaces and a @verifier on a shared board.

/run-workflow.description: Run parallel() and pipeline() Python workflows across many files or staged phases.

/schedule.description: Schedule a one-shot timer or recurring cron check inside the active conversation.

/automation.description: Create a persistent App sidecar automation (sidecar.json with CRON_TZ), dormant until enabled.

/browser.description: Delegate live web UI inspection, interaction, and screenshots to the browser subagent.

/boost.description: Three-tier multi-agent deep reasoning hierarchy for hard coupled bugs, races, and algorithms.

/goal.description: Harness-owned continuous loop that keeps running until the done predicate holds.

/teamwork.description: Sentinel scoping interview, binding spec, and agent teams for multi-day campaigns.

/btw.description: Ask a read-only contextual side question without pausing active agents or cluttering history.

/learn.description: Distill session corrections into durable rules or skills via learning_proposal.md.

/agy-customizations.description: Load Antigravity schemas, discovery precedence, and formats before authoring customizations.

/antigravity-guide.description: Answer questions about Antigravity App, CLI, IDE, Remote Agents, and SDK from official docs.

/generative_ui.description: Build interactive HTML widgets in the App or fall back to Mermaid in the CLI.

/mcp-app-development.description: Build and package single-file ui:// MCP Apps for inline chat cards and side panes.

/plugin.description: Open the Plugins Manager or manage, validate, and package Antigravity plugins.

/compact.description: Compact long conversation history to free context window capacity without losing active task state.

subagents.description: Spawn focused background subagents (astack-agent, research, browser, comment-sicko, pr-verifier).

research.description: Read-only research subagents spawned by /how and /why to trace callers and history.

examples.label: First-time setup
examples.prompt: /setup-astack
examples.how: Checks verification skills, formal checks, and opt-in hooks once per repository.

examples.label: Verify skill
examples.prompt: /create-verification-skill Inspect this app's primary user flow and generate .agents/skills/verify-app/ with an end-to-end check.
examples.how: Scaffolds a project-local verification skill and feature map for live checks.

examples.label: Formal check
examples.prompt: /create-formal-verification-skill Model the job lease and retry state so a job never runs twice at once.
examples.how: Generates a TLA+ or TypeScript invariant verifier for concurrency or state machines.

examples.label: Plan first
examples.prompt: /plan /astack-mode Add per-IP login rate limiting on login requests and stop with implementation_plan.md for approval.
examples.how: Inspects read-only and pauses at implementation_plan.md until you click Proceed.

examples.label: Clarify idea
examples.prompt: /plan /grill-me /astack-mode Let workspace admins export audit logs from the settings page.
examples.how: Asks one clarifying question at a time, then drafts the implementation plan.

examples.label: Understand code
examples.prompt: Use /how to explain how the trust receipt ledger works, then /why to trace why stale_sha invalidates prior proof.
examples.how: Traces current mechanics and git or PR rationale read-only before editing.

examples.label: Compare designs
examples.prompt: /architect Design a shared webhook retry contract across packages/http-api and packages/worker. With checkpoint before coding.
examples.how: Compares candidate module boundaries in parallel and screens for design red flags.

examples.label: Restate spec
examples.prompt: /in-your-own-words Read the linked spec and restate the date boundary rules and failure exit codes without editing files.
examples.how: Catches misreads on messy threads before any workspace file changes.

examples.label: Feature or fix
examples.prompt: /astack-mode Implement --dry-run on prune-sessions, run /deslop and /no-comments, and prove row counts stay unchanged via /control-cli.
examples.how: Runs the matching playbook, cleans the diff, and proves behavior on the live surface.

examples.label: UI check
examples.prompt: /browser Open http://localhost:3000, drive the timeline sidecar, verify receipts render with zero console errors, and capture a screenshot.
examples.how: AStack runs it under /control-ui during Build & Prove.

examples.label: Broad split
examples.prompt: /swarm /astack-mode <task>. One worker per file or package in isolated workspaces, plus a @verifier that runs tests before sign-off.
examples.how: AStack runs it for broad Build & Prove work and stacked PRs.

examples.label: Hard bug
examples.prompt: /boost /astack-mode <hard bug>. Reproduce it, isolate the root cause, fix it, and prove it with repeated clean runs.
examples.how: AStack suggests it from the bug-fix, perf-issue, and hillclimb playbooks. You start it.

examples.label: Until done
examples.prompt: /goal /astack-mode <task>. Done when <checkable predicate>.
examples.how: AStack drafts the predicate. Hand it an approved plan and start the run.

examples.label: Multi-day
examples.prompt: /teamwork /astack-mode <repo-scale migration> with a scoping interview and milestone audit gates.
examples.how: Starts with a scoping interview, then runs across milestones. Pairs with orchestrate.

stages.title: PR Review
stages.subtitle: Prove safety and catch real bugs

examples.label: PR proof gate
examples.prompt: /review-pr Compile pr-review.md with blast-radius tier and receipts, then run isolated pr-verifier against REVIEW.md.
examples.how: Compiles the review dossier and runs a fresh-context verifier before opening a PR.

examples.label: Many files
examples.prompt: /run-workflow Review the changed files on this branch in parallel, one reviewer per file, then run pr-verifier once on HEAD and log a one-line verdict per file.
examples.how: AStack runs it when many files or packages share the same staged pass.

examples.label: Skeptical audit
examples.prompt: /interrogate Review this branch skeptically for real bugs and regressions. Keep only live-reproduced findings.
examples.how: Challenges assumptions adversarially and filters out style noise.

examples.label: Batch of PRs
examples.prompt: /fanout Review PR #231, #232, and #235 in isolated branch workspaces, run affected tests, and return one consolidated report.
examples.how: Runs parallel subagent checks without spinning up a swarm board.

examples.label: Downstream safety
examples.prompt: /blast-radius Prove downstream callers, wire formats, and persisted state stay safe by running real code.
examples.how: Verifies caller contracts beyond the diff before shipping.

examples.label: Security check
examples.prompt: /security-audit Audit trust boundaries, input validation, and auth paths touched by this diff.
examples.how: Runs PR-diff boundary guidance or a 6-phase coverage-led vulnerability audit.

stages.title: Ship
stages.subtitle: Open PR, track CI, and encode lessons

examples.label: Clean & open PR
examples.kicker: Clean & open PR · /astack-mode open the pr
examples.prompt: /astack-mode Run /deslop and /no-comments over this diff, rebase clean commits, and open the PR with proof.
examples.how: Cleans the branch, attaches verified receipts, and opens the PR.

examples.label: Watch CI & threads
examples.prompt: /schedule every 10 minutes check watch-pr.mjs --pr <n> --status-only and wake me when CI finishes or new review comments arrive.
examples.how: /astack-mode babysit re-arms this timer during Ship until the PR is merge-ready.

examples.label: Land stack
examples.prompt: /astack-mode land the stack. Verify each PR via an independent verifier and merge bottom-up.
examples.how: Requires an independent @verifier check per PR and lands contiguous green runs.

examples.label: Recurring check
examples.prompt: /automation every weekday at 9am run /maintain-verification-skill on this repository and post a summary of clean, changed, or blocked features.
examples.how: App only. AStack creates it dormant; you turn it on in the Automations tab.

examples.label: Encode lessons
examples.prompt: /correct Turn the repeat mistake from this session into a type check, lint, or test, then run /learn to propose a durable rule.
examples.how: Turns session corrections into structural checks and workspace rules.

examples.label: Quick question
examples.prompt: /btw Which file defines the receipt freshness check?
examples.how: Opens a Side Question tab. Nothing is added to the main conversation.

examples.label: Side task
examples.prompt: Delegate to a research subagent: map every caller of resolveTrustDir and report file and line.
examples.how: AStack spawns focused background workers: astack-agent, research, browser, comment-sicko, and pr-verifier.

examples.label: Pick a skill
examples.prompt: /astack-help Which AStack skill or native command fits this task? Recommend one copy-ready prompt without editing files.
examples.how: Inspects workspace readiness and outputs one copy-ready prompt with zero edits.

examples.label: Checkpoint context
examples.prompt: /compact Compact this long conversation to free up context window capacity without losing active task state.
examples.how: Compacts long conversation history to free up context without losing active task state.

delegateMenu.prompt: /swarm <task>. One worker per file or package, plus a @verifier that runs the tests before sign-off.

delegateMenu.summary: Stuck on a hard bug or a race
delegateMenu.prompt: /boost /astack-mode <hard bug>. Reproduce it, isolate the root cause, fix it, and prove it with repeated clean runs.
/run-workflow For each package, apply <change> in an isolated branch workspace, run its tests, and log a one-line result per package.
/schedule in 30 minutes re-run node --run test and tell me if anything regressed.
